lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately six distinct vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin junction, with each column containing 3 to 5 nodes of peak luminance.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to create a structured grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two dominant horizontal linear features are visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with lighter pixels on the superior aspect and a shadow-casting transition on the inferior aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin contains a dense, stochastic distribution of smaller high-luminance spots that contrast with the more geometrically ordered columns of the lateral flank.
